commands.run: if [ -f scripts/remote-check.sh ]; then bash scripts/remote-check.sh 'OPERAD_TEST_PARALLEL=${OPERAD_TEST_PARALLEL:-$(p=$(( $(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 4) / (${OPERAD_CHECK_SLOTS:-1} + 1) )); echo $(( p > 1 ? p : 1 )))} bash scripts/check-changed.sh'; else bash scripts/verify.sh; fi

failed.rerun: if [ -f scripts/remote-check.sh ]; then bash scripts/remote-check.sh -- bun test --timeout 30000 -t {pattern}; else bun test --timeout 30000 -t {pattern}; fi

keyCommands.run: OPERAD_CHECK_LANE=integration bash scripts/remote-check.sh 'OPERAD_TEST_PARALLEL=${OPERAD_TEST_PARALLEL:-$(p=$(( $(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 4) / (${OPERAD_CHECK_SLOTS:-1} + 1) )); echo $(( p > 1 ? p : 1 )))} bash scripts/verify.sh'

failed.rerun: if [ -f scripts/remote-check.sh ]; then bash scripts/remote-check.sh -- bun test --timeout 30000 -t {pattern}; else bun test --timeout 30000 -t {pattern}; fi
